content.latin: Psalmus 44 [3]
content.english: Psalm 44 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 44

content.latin: 44:2 Eructávit cor meum verbum bonum: * dico ego ópera mea Regi.
content.english: 44:2 My heart hath uttered a good word; * I speak my works to the King.

segments.t: Eructávit cor meum verbum bonum: * dico ego ópera mea Regi.

content.latin: 44:2 Lingua mea cálamus scribæ: * velóciter scribéntis.
content.english: 44:2 My tongue is the pen of a scrivener * that writeth swiftly.

segments.t: Lingua mea cálamus scribæ: * velóciter scribéntis.

content.latin: 44:3 Speciósus forma præ fíliis hóminum, diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis: * proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
content.english: 44:3 Thou art beautiful above the sons of men: grace is poured abroad in thy lips; * therefore hath God blessed thee for ever.

segments.t: Speciósus forma præ fíliis hóminum, diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis: * proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.

content.latin: 44:4 Accíngere gládio tuo super femur tuum, * potentíssime.
content.english: 44:4 Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, * O thou most mighty.

segments.t: Accíngere gládio tuo super femur tuum, * potentíssime.

content.latin: 44:5 Spécie tua et pulchritúdine tua: * inténde, próspere procéde, et regna.
content.english: 44:5 With thy comeliness and thy beauty * set out, proceed prosperously, and reign.

segments.t: Spécie tua et pulchritúdine tua: * inténde, próspere procéde, et regna.

content.latin: 44:5 Propter veritátem, et mansuetúdinem, et iustítiam: * et dedúcet te mirabíliter déxtera tua.
content.english: 44:5 Because of truth and meekness and justice: * and thy right hand shall conduct thee wonderfully.

segments.t: Propter veritátem, et mansuetúdinem, et iustítiam: * et dedúcet te mirabíliter déxtera tua.

content.latin: 44:6 Sagíttæ tuæ acútæ, pópuli sub te cadent: * in corda inimicórum Regis.
content.english: 44:6 Thy arrows are sharp: under thee shall people fall, * into the hearts of the king’s enemies.

segments.t: Sagíttæ tuæ acútæ, pópuli sub te cadent: * in corda inimicórum Regis.

content.latin: 44:7 Sedes tua, Deus, in sǽculum sǽculi: * virga directiónis virga regni tui.
content.english: 44:7 Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: * the sceptre of thy kingdom is a sceptre of uprightness.

segments.t: Sedes tua, Deus, in sǽculum sǽculi: * virga directiónis virga regni tui.

content.latin: 44:8 Dilexísti iustítiam, et odísti iniquitátem: * proptérea unxit te Deus, Deus tuus, óleo lætítiæ præ consórtibus tuis.
content.english: 44:8 Thou hast loved justice, and hated iniquity: * therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

segments.t: Dilexísti iustítiam, et odísti iniquitátem: * proptérea unxit te Deus, Deus tuus, óleo lætítiæ præ consórtibus tuis.

content.latin: 44:9 Myrrha, et gutta, et cásia a vestiméntis tuis, a dómibus ebúrneis: * ex quibus delectavérunt te fíliæ regum in honóre tuo.
content.english: 44:9 Myrrh and stacte and cassia perfume thy garments, from the ivory houses: * out of which the daughters of kings have delighted thee in thy glory.

segments.t: Myrrha, et gutta, et cásia a vestiméntis tuis, a dómibus ebúrneis: * ex quibus delectavérunt te fíliæ regum in honóre tuo.

content.latin: 44:10 Ástitit regína a dextris tuis in vestítu deauráto: * circúmdata varietáte.
content.english: 44:10 The queen stood on thy right hand, in gilded clothing; * surrounded with variety.

segments.t: Ástitit regína a dextris tuis in vestítu deauráto: * circúmdata varietáte.

content.latin: 44:11 Audi fília, et vide, et inclína aurem tuam: * et oblivíscere pópulum tuum et domum patris tui.
content.english: 44:11 Hearken, O daughter, and see, and incline thy ear: * and forget thy people and thy father’s house.

segments.t: Audi fília, et vide, et inclína aurem tuam: * et oblivíscere pópulum tuum et domum patris tui.

content.latin: 44:12 Et concupíscet Rex decórem tuum: * quóniam ipse est Dóminus Deus tuus, et adorábunt eum.
content.english: 44:12 And the king shall greatly desire thy beauty; * for he is the Lord thy God, and him they shall adore.

segments.t: Et concupíscet Rex decórem tuum: * quóniam ipse est Dóminus Deus tuus, et adorábunt eum.

content.latin: 44:13 Et fíliæ Tyri in munéribus * vultum tuum deprecabúntur: omnes dívites plebis.
content.english: 44:13 And the daughters of Tyre with gifts, * yea, all the rich among the people, shall entreat thy countenance.

segments.t: Et fíliæ Tyri in munéribus * vultum tuum deprecabúntur: omnes dívites plebis.

content.latin: 44:14 Omnis glória eius fíliæ Regis ab intus, * in fímbriis áureis circumamícta varietátibus.
content.english: 44:14 All the glory of the king’s daughter is within, * in golden borders, clothed round about with varieties.

segments.t: Omnis glória eius fíliæ Regis ab intus, * in fímbriis áureis circumamícta varietátibus.

content.latin: 44:15 Adducéntur Regi vírgines post eam: * próximæ eius afferéntur tibi.
content.english: 44:15 After her shall virgins be brought to the king: * her neighbours shall be brought to thee.

segments.t: Adducéntur Regi vírgines post eam: * próximæ eius afferéntur tibi.

content.latin: 44:16 Afferéntur in lætítia et exsultatióne: * adducéntur in templum Regis.
content.english: 44:16 They shall be brought with gladness and rejoicing: * they shall be brought into the temple of the king.

segments.t: Afferéntur in lætítia et exsultatióne: * adducéntur in templum Regis.

content.latin: 44:17 Pro pátribus tuis nati sunt tibi fílii: * constítues eos príncipes super omnem terram.
content.english: 44:17 Instead of thy fathers, sons are born to thee: * thou shalt make them princes over all the earth.

segments.t: Pro pátribus tuis nati sunt tibi fílii: * constítues eos príncipes super omnem terram.

content.latin: 44:18 Mémores erunt nóminis tui: * in omni generatióne et generatiónem.
content.english: 44:18 They shall remember thy name * throughout all generations.

segments.t: Mémores erunt nóminis tui: * in omni generatióne et generatiónem.

content.latin: 44:18 Proptérea pópuli confitebúntur tibi in ætérnum: * et in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 44:18 Therefore shall people praise thee for ever; yea, * for ever and ever.

segments.t: Proptérea pópuli confitebúntur tibi in ætérnum: * et in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis, proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
content.english: Ant. Grace is poured into thy lips, therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

segments.t: Ant.
Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis, proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.

content.latin: Ant. Suscépimus, * Deus, misericórdiam tuam in médio templi tui.
content.english: Ant. We have drunk in thy loving-kindness, * O God, in the midst of thy temple.

segments.t: Ant.
Suscépimus, * Deus, misericórdiam tuam in médio templi tui.

content.latin: Psalmus 47 [4]
content.english: Psalm 47 [4]

segments.t: Psalmus 47

content.latin: 47:2 Magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis * in civitáte Dei nostri, in monte sancto eius.
content.english: 47:2 Great is the Lord, and exceedingly to be praised * in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

segments.t: Magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis * in civitáte Dei nostri, in monte sancto eius.

content.latin: 47:3 Fundátur exsultatióne univérsæ terræ mons Sion, * látera Aquilónis, cívitas Regis magni.
content.english: 47:3 With the joy of the whole earth is mount Sion founded, * on the sides of the north, the city of the great king.

segments.t: Fundátur exsultatióne univérsæ terræ mons Sion, * látera Aquilónis, cívitas Regis magni.

content.latin: 47:4 Deus in dómibus eius cognoscétur: * cum suscípiet eam.
content.english: 47:4 In her houses shall God be known, * when he shall protect her.

segments.t: Deus in dómibus eius cognoscétur: * cum suscípiet eam.

content.latin: 47:5 Quóniam ecce reges terræ congregáti sunt: * convenérunt in unum.
content.english: 47:5 For behold the kings of the earth assembled themselves: * they gathered together.

segments.t: Quóniam ecce reges terræ congregáti sunt: * convenérunt in unum.

content.latin: 47:6 Ipsi vidéntes sic admiráti sunt, conturbáti sunt, commóti sunt: * tremor apprehéndit eos.
content.english: 47:6 So they saw, and they wondered, they were troubled, they were moved: * trembling took hold of them.

segments.t: Ipsi vidéntes sic admiráti sunt, conturbáti sunt, commóti sunt: * tremor apprehéndit eos.

content.latin: 47:7 Ibi dolóres ut parturiéntis: * in spíritu veheménti cónteres naves Tharsis.
content.english: 47:7 There were pains as of a woman in labour; * with a vehement wind thou shalt break in pieces the ships of Tharsis.

segments.t: Ibi dolóres ut parturiéntis: * in spíritu veheménti cónteres naves Tharsis.

content.latin: 47:9 Sicut audívimus, sic vídimus in civitáte Dómini virtútum, in civitáte Dei nostri: * Deus fundávit eam in ætérnum.
content.english: 47:9 As we have heard, so have we seen, in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: * God hath founded it for ever.

segments.t: Sicut audívimus, sic vídimus in civitáte Dómini virtútum, in civitáte Dei nostri: * Deus fundávit eam in ætérnum.

content.latin: 47:10 Suscépimus, Deus, misericórdiam tuam, * in médio templi tui.
content.english: 47:10 We have received thy mercy, O God, * in the midst of thy temple.

segments.t: Suscépimus, Deus, misericórdiam tuam, * in médio templi tui.

content.latin: 47:11 Secúndum nomen tuum, Deus, sic et laus tua in fines terræ: * iustítia plena est déxtera tua.
content.english: 47:11 According to thy name, O God, so also is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: * thy right hand is full of justice.

segments.t: Secúndum nomen tuum, Deus, sic et laus tua in fines terræ: * iustítia plena est déxtera tua.

content.latin: 47:12 Lætétur mons Sion, et exsúltent fíliæ Iudæ: * propter iudícia tua, Dómine.
content.english: 47:12 Let mount Sion rejoice, and the daughters of Juda be glad; * because of thy judgments, O Lord.

segments.t: Lætétur mons Sion, et exsúltent fíliæ Iudæ: * propter iudícia tua, Dómine.

content.latin: 47:13 Circúmdate Sion, et complectímini eam: * narráte in túrribus eius.
content.english: 47:13 Surround Sion, and encompass her: * tell ye in her towers.

segments.t: Circúmdate Sion, et complectímini eam: * narráte in túrribus eius.

content.latin: 47:14 Pónite corda vestra in virtúte eius: * et distribúite domos eius, ut enarrétis in progénie áltera.
content.english: 47:14 Set your hearts on her strength; and distribute her houses, * that ye may relate it in another generation.

segments.t: Pónite corda vestra in virtúte eius: * et distribúite domos eius, ut enarrétis in progénie áltera.

content.latin: 47:15 Quóniam hic est Deus, Deus noster in ætérnum et in sǽculum sǽculi: * ipse reget nos in sǽcula.
content.english: 47:15 For this is God, our God unto eternity, and for ever and ever: * he shall rule us for evermore.

segments.t: Quóniam hic est Deus, Deus noster in ætérnum et in sǽculum sǽculi: * ipse reget nos in sǽcula.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Suscépimus, Deus, misericórdiam tuam in médio templi tui.
content.english: Ant. We have drunk in thy loving-kindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

segments.t: Ant.
Suscépimus, Deus, misericórdiam tuam in médio templi tui.

content.latin: Ant. Oriétur * in diébus Dómini abundántia pacis, et dominábitur.
content.english: Ant. In the Lord's days * shall abundance of peace arise and flourish.

segments.t: Ant.
Oriétur * in diébus Dómini abundántia pacis, et dominábitur.

content.latin: Psalmus 71 [5]
content.english: Psalm 71 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 71

content.latin: 71:2 Deus, iudícium tuum regi da: * et iustítiam tuam fílio regis:
content.english: 71:2 Give to the king thy judgment, O God: * and to the king’s son thy justice:

segments.t: Deus, iudícium tuum regi da: * et iustítiam tuam fílio regis:

content.latin: 71:2 Iudicáre pópulum tuum in iustítia, * et páuperes tuos in iudício.
content.english: 71:2 To judge thy people with justice, * and thy poor with judgment.

segments.t: Iudicáre pópulum tuum in iustítia, * et páuperes tuos in iudício.

content.latin: 71:3 Suscípiant montes pacem pópulo: * et colles iustítiam.
content.english: 71:3 Let the mountains receive peace for the people: * and the hills justice.

segments.t: Suscípiant montes pacem pópulo: * et colles iustítiam.

content.latin: 71:4 Iudicábit páuperes pópuli, et salvos fáciet fílios páuperum: * et humiliábit calumniatórem.
content.english: 71:4 He shall judge the poor of the people, and he shall save the children of the poor: * and he shall humble the oppressor.

segments.t: Iudicábit páuperes pópuli, et salvos fáciet fílios páuperum: * et humiliábit calumniatórem.

content.latin: 71:5 Et permanébit cum sole, et ante lunam, * in generatióne et generatiónem.
content.english: 71:5 And he shall continue with the sun, and before the moon, * throughout all generations.

segments.t: Et permanébit cum sole, et ante lunam, * in generatióne et generatiónem.

content.latin: 71:6 Descéndet sicut plúvia in vellus: * et sicut stillicídia stillántia super terram.
content.english: 71:6 He shall come down like rain upon the fleece; * and as showers falling gently upon the earth.

segments.t: Descéndet sicut plúvia in vellus: * et sicut stillicídia stillántia super terram.

content.latin: 71:7 Oriétur in diébus eius iustítia, et abundántia pacis: * donec auferátur luna.
content.english: 71:7 In his days shall justice spring up, and abundance of peace, * till the moon be taken away.

segments.t: Oriétur in diébus eius iustítia, et abundántia pacis: * donec auferátur luna.

content.latin: 71:8 Et dominábitur a mari usque ad mare: * et a flúmine usque ad términos orbis terrárum.
content.english: 71:8 And he shall rule from sea to sea, * and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

segments.t: Et dominábitur a mari usque ad mare: * et a flúmine usque ad términos orbis terrárum.

content.latin: 71:9 Coram illo prócident Æthíopes: * et inimíci eius terram lingent.
content.english: 71:9 Before him the Ethiopians shall fall down: * and his enemies shall lick the ground.

segments.t: Coram illo prócident Æthíopes: * et inimíci eius terram lingent.

content.latin: 71:10 Reges Tharsis, et ínsulæ múnera ófferent: * reges Árabum et Saba dona addúcent.
content.english: 71:10 The kings of Tharsis and the islands shall offer presents: * the kings of the Arabians and of Saba shall bring gifts:

segments.t: Reges Tharsis, et ínsulæ múnera ófferent: * reges Árabum et Saba dona addúcent.

content.latin: 71:11 Et adorábunt eum omnes reges terræ: * omnes gentes sérvient ei:
content.english: 71:11 And all kings of the earth shall adore him: * all nations shall serve him.

segments.t: Et adorábunt eum omnes reges terræ: * omnes gentes sérvient ei:

content.latin: 71:12 Quia liberábit páuperem a poténte: * et páuperem, cui non erat adiútor.
content.english: 71:12 For he shall deliver the poor from the mighty: * and the needy that had no helper.

segments.t: Quia liberábit páuperem a poténte: * et páuperem, cui non erat adiútor.

content.latin: 71:13 Parcet páuperi et ínopi: * et ánimas páuperum salvas fáciet.
content.english: 71:13 He shall spare the poor and needy: * and he shall save the souls of the poor.

segments.t: Parcet páuperi et ínopi: * et ánimas páuperum salvas fáciet.

content.latin: 71:14 Ex usúris et iniquitáte rédimet ánimas eórum: * et honorábile nomen eórum coram illo.
content.english: 71:14 He shall redeem their souls from usuries and iniquity: * and their names shall be honourable in his sight.

segments.t: Ex usúris et iniquitáte rédimet ánimas eórum: * et honorábile nomen eórum coram illo.

content.latin: 71:15 Et vivet, et dábitur ei de auro Arábiæ, et adorábunt de ipso semper: * tota die benedícent ei.
content.english: 71:15 And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Arabia, for him they shall always adore: * they shall bless him all the day.

segments.t: Et vivet, et dábitur ei de auro Arábiæ, et adorábunt de ipso semper: * tota die benedícent ei.

content.latin: 71:16 Et erit firmaméntum in terra in summis móntium, superextollétur super Líbanum fructus eius: * et florébunt de civitáte sicut fænum terræ.
content.english: 71:16 And there shall be a firmament on the earth on the tops of mountains, above Libanus shall the fruit thereof be exalted: * and they of the city shall flourish like the grass of the earth.

segments.t: Et erit firmaméntum in terra in summis móntium, superextollétur super Líbanum fructus eius: * et florébunt de civitáte sicut fænum terræ.

content.latin: 71:17 Sit nomen eius benedíctum in sǽcula: * ante solem pérmanet nomen eius.
content.english: 71:17 Let his name be blessed for evermore: * his name continueth before the sun.

segments.t: Sit nomen eius benedíctum in sǽcula: * ante solem pérmanet nomen eius.

content.latin: 71:17 Et benedicéntur in ipso omnes tribus terræ: * omnes gentes magnificábunt eum.
content.english: 71:17 And in him shall all the tribes of the earth be blessed: * all nations shall magnify him.

segments.t: Et benedicéntur in ipso omnes tribus terræ: * omnes gentes magnificábunt eum.

content.latin: 71:18 Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, * qui facit mirabília solus:
content.english: 71:18 Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, * who alone doth wonderful things.

segments.t: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, * qui facit mirabília solus:

content.latin: 71:19 Et benedíctum nomen maiestátis eius in ætérnum: * et replébitur maiestáte eius omnis terra: fiat, fiat.
content.english: 71:19 And blessed be the name of his majesty for ever: * and the whole earth shall be filled with his majesty. So be it. So be it.

segments.t: Et benedíctum nomen maiestátis eius in ætérnum: * et replébitur maiestáte eius omnis terra: fiat, fiat.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Oriétur in diébus Dómini abundántia pacis, et dominábitur.
content.english: Ant. In the Lord's days shall abundance of peace arise and flourish.

segments.t: Ant.
Oriétur in diébus Dómini abundántia pacis, et dominábitur.

content.latin: Ant. Véritas de terra * orta est, et iustítia de cælo prospéxit.
content.english: Ant. Truth is sprung out of the earth, * and righteousness hath looked down from heaven.

segments.t: Ant.
Véritas de terra * orta est, et iustítia de cælo prospéxit.

content.latin: Psalmus 84 [6]
content.english: Psalm 84 [6]

segments.t: Psalmus 84

content.latin: 84:2 Benedixísti, Dómine, terram tuam: * avertísti captivitátem Iacob.
content.english: 84:2 Lord, thou hast blessed thy land: * thou hast turned away the captivity of Jacob.

segments.t: Benedixísti, Dómine, terram tuam: * avertísti captivitátem Iacob.

content.latin: 84:3 Remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ: * operuísti ómnia peccáta eórum.
content.english: 84:3 Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people: * thou hast covered all their sins.

segments.t: Remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ: * operuísti ómnia peccáta eórum.

content.latin: 84:4 Mitigásti omnem iram tuam: * avertísti ab ira indignatiónis tuæ.
content.english: 84:4 Thou hast mitigated all thy anger: * thou hast turned away from the wrath of thy indignation.

segments.t: Mitigásti omnem iram tuam: * avertísti ab ira indignatiónis tuæ.

content.latin: 84:5 Convérte nos, Deus, salutáris noster: * et avérte iram tuam a nobis.
content.english: 84:5 Convert us, O God our saviour: * and turn off thy anger from us.

segments.t: Convérte nos, Deus, salutáris noster: * et avérte iram tuam a nobis.

content.latin: 84:6 Numquid in ætérnum irascéris nobis? * aut exténdes iram tuam a generatióne in generatiónem?
content.english: 84:6 Wilt thou be angry with us for ever: * or wilt thou extend thy wrath from generation to generation?

segments.t: Numquid in ætérnum irascéris nobis? * aut exténdes iram tuam a generatióne in generatiónem?

content.latin: 84:7 Deus, tu convérsus vivificábis nos: * et plebs tua lætábitur in te.
content.english: 84:7 Thou wilt turn, O God, and bring us to life: * and thy people shall rejoice in thee.

segments.t: Deus, tu convérsus vivificábis nos: * et plebs tua lætábitur in te.

content.latin: 84:8 Osténde nobis, Dómine, misericórdiam tuam: * et salutáre tuum da nobis.
content.english: 84:8 Shew us, O Lord, thy mercy; * and grant us thy salvation.

segments.t: Osténde nobis, Dómine, misericórdiam tuam: * et salutáre tuum da nobis.

content.latin: 84:9 Áudiam quid loquátur in me Dóminus Deus: * quóniam loquétur pacem in plebem suam.
content.english: 84:9 I will hear what the Lord God will speak in me: * for he will speak peace

segments.t: Áudiam quid loquátur in me Dóminus Deus: * quóniam loquétur pacem in plebem suam.

content.latin: 84:9 Et super sanctos suos: * et in eos, qui convertúntur ad cor.
content.english: 84:9 And unto his saints: * and unto them that are converted to the heart.

segments.t: Et super sanctos suos: * et in eos, qui convertúntur ad cor.

content.latin: 84:10 Verúmtamen prope timéntes eum salutáre ipsíus: * ut inhábitet glória in terra nostra.
content.english: 84:10 Surely his salvation is near to them that fear him: * that glory may dwell in our land.

segments.t: Verúmtamen prope timéntes eum salutáre ipsíus: * ut inhábitet glória in terra nostra.

content.latin: 84:11 Misericórdia, et véritas obviavérunt sibi: * iustítia, et pax osculátæ sunt.
content.english: 84:11 Mercy and truth have met each other: * justice and peace have kissed.

segments.t: Misericórdia, et véritas obviavérunt sibi: * iustítia, et pax osculátæ sunt.

content.latin: 84:12 Véritas de terra orta est: * et iustítia de cælo prospéxit.
content.english: 84:12 Truth is sprung out of the earth: * and justice hath looked down from heaven.

segments.t: Véritas de terra orta est: * et iustítia de cælo prospéxit.

content.latin: 84:13 Étenim Dóminus dabit benignitátem: * et terra nostra dabit fructum suum.
content.english: 84:13 For the Lord will give goodness: * and our earth shall yield her fruit.

segments.t: Étenim Dóminus dabit benignitátem: * et terra nostra dabit fructum suum.

content.latin: 84:14 Iustítia ante eum ambulábit: * et ponet in via gressus suos.
content.english: 84:14 Justice shall walk before him: * and shall set his steps in the way.

segments.t: Iustítia ante eum ambulábit: * et ponet in via gressus suos.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Véritas de terra orta est, et iustítia de cælo prospéxit.
content.english: Ant. Truth is sprung out of the earth, and righteousness hath looked down from heaven.

segments.t: Ant.
Véritas de terra orta est, et iustítia de cælo prospéxit.

content.latin: Ant. Ipse invocábit * me, allelúia: Pater meus es tu, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. He shall cry unto Me, alleluia, * Thou art My Father, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Ipse invocábit * me, allelúia: Pater meus es tu, allelúia.
Psalmus 88(2-37)

content.latin: 88:2 Misericórdias Dómini * in ætérnum cantábo.
content.english: 88:2 The mercies of the Lord * I will sing for ever.

segments.t: Misericórdias Dómini * in ætérnum cantábo.

content.latin: 88:2 In generatiónem et generatiónem * annuntiábo veritátem tuam in ore meo.
content.english: 88:2 I will shew forth thy truth with my mouth * to generation and generation.

segments.t: In generatiónem et generatiónem * annuntiábo veritátem tuam in ore meo.

content.latin: 88:3 Quóniam dixísti: In ætérnum misericórdia ædificábitur in cælis: * præparábitur véritas tua in eis.
content.english: 88:3 For thou hast said: Mercy shall be built up for ever in the heavens: * thy truth shall be prepared in them.

segments.t: Quóniam dixísti: In ætérnum misericórdia ædificábitur in cælis: * præparábitur véritas tua in eis.

content.latin: 88:4 Dispósui testaméntum eléctis meis, iurávi David, servo meo: * Usque in ætérnum præparábo semen tuum.
content.english: 88:4 I have made a covenant with my elect: I have sworn to David my servant: * Thy seed will I settle for ever.

segments.t: Dispósui testaméntum eléctis meis, iurávi David, servo meo: * Usque in ætérnum præparábo semen tuum.

content.latin: 88:5 Et ædificábo in generatiónem et generatiónem * sedem tuam.
content.english: 88:5 And I will build up thy throne * unto generation and generation.

segments.t: Et ædificábo in generatiónem et generatiónem * sedem tuam.

content.latin: 88:6 Confitebúntur cæli mirabília tua, Dómine: * étenim veritátem tuam in ecclésia sanctórum.
content.english: 88:6 The heavens shall confess thy wonders, O Lord: * and thy truth in the church of the saints.

segments.t: Confitebúntur cæli mirabília tua, Dómine: * étenim veritátem tuam in ecclésia sanctórum.

content.latin: 88:7 Quóniam quis in núbibus æquábitur Dómino: * símilis erit Deo in fíliis Dei?
content.english: 88:7 For who in the clouds can be compared to the Lord: * or who among the sons of God shall be like to God?

segments.t: Quóniam quis in núbibus æquábitur Dómino: * símilis erit Deo in fíliis Dei?

content.latin: 88:8 Deus, qui glorificátur in consílio sanctórum: * magnus et terríbilis super omnes qui in circúitu eius sunt.
content.english: 88:8 God, who is glorified in the assembly of the saints: * great and terrible above all them that are about him.

segments.t: Deus, qui glorificátur in consílio sanctórum: * magnus et terríbilis super omnes qui in circúitu eius sunt.

content.latin: 88:9 Dómine, Deus virtútum, quis símilis tibi? * potens es, Dómine, et véritas tua in circúitu tuo.
content.english: 88:9 O Lord God of hosts, who is like to thee? * thou art mighty, O Lord, and thy truth is round about thee.

segments.t: Dómine, Deus virtútum, quis símilis tibi? * potens es, Dómine, et véritas tua in circúitu tuo.

content.latin: 88:10 Tu domináris potestáti maris: * motum autem flúctuum eius tu mítigas.
content.english: 88:10 Thou rulest the power of the sea: * and appeasest the motion of the waves thereof.

segments.t: Tu domináris potestáti maris: * motum autem flúctuum eius tu mítigas.

content.latin: 88:11 Tu humiliásti sicut vulnerátum, supérbum: * in brácchio virtútis tuæ dispersísti inimícos tuos.
content.english: 88:11 Thou hast humbled the proud one, as one that is slain: * with the arm of thy strength thou hast scattered thy enemies.

segments.t: Tu humiliásti sicut vulnerátum, supérbum: * in brácchio virtútis tuæ dispersísti inimícos tuos.

content.latin: 88:12 Tui sunt cæli, et tua est terra, orbem terræ et plenitúdinem eius tu fundásti: * aquilónem, et mare tu creásti.
content.english: 88:12 Thine are the heavens, and thine is the earth: the world and the fulness thereof thou hast founded: * the north and the sea thou hast created.

segments.t: Tui sunt cæli, et tua est terra, orbem terræ et plenitúdinem eius tu fundásti: * aquilónem, et mare tu creásti.

content.latin: 88:13 Thabor et Hermon in nómine tuo exsultábunt: * tuum brácchium cum poténtia.
content.english: 88:13 Thabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name: * thy arm is with might.

segments.t: Thabor et Hermon in nómine tuo exsultábunt: * tuum brácchium cum poténtia.

content.latin: 88:14 Firmétur manus tua, et exaltétur déxtera tua: * iustítia et iudícium præparátio sedis tuæ.
content.english: 88:14 Let thy hand be strengthened, and thy right hand exalted: * justice and judgment are the preparation of thy throne.

segments.t: Firmétur manus tua, et exaltétur déxtera tua: * iustítia et iudícium præparátio sedis tuæ.

content.latin: 88:15 Misericórdia et véritas præcédent fáciem tuam: * beátus pópulus, qui scit iubilatiónem.
content.english: 88:15 Mercy and truth shall go before thy face: * blessed is the people that knoweth jubilation.

segments.t: Misericórdia et véritas præcédent fáciem tuam: * beátus pópulus, qui scit iubilatiónem.

content.latin: 88:16 Dómine, in lúmine vultus tui ambulábunt, et in nómine tuo exsultábunt tota die: * et in iustítia tua exaltabúntur.
content.english: 88:16 They shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance: and in thy name they shall rejoice all the day, * and in thy justice they shall be exalted.

segments.t: Dómine, in lúmine vultus tui ambulábunt, et in nómine tuo exsultábunt tota die: * et in iustítia tua exaltabúntur.

content.latin: 88:18 Quóniam glória virtútis eórum tu es: * et in beneplácito tuo exaltábitur cornu nostrum.
content.english: 88:18 For thou art the glory of their strength: * and in thy good pleasure shall our horn be exalted.

segments.t: Quóniam glória virtútis eórum tu es: * et in beneplácito tuo exaltábitur cornu nostrum.

content.latin: 88:19 Quia Dómini est assúmptio nostra, * et Sancti Israël, regis nostri.
content.english: 88:19 For our protection is of the Lord, * and of our king the holy one of Israel.

segments.t: Quia Dómini est assúmptio nostra, * et Sancti Israël, regis nostri.

content.latin: 88:20 Tunc locútus es in visióne sanctis tuis, et dixísti: * Pósui adiutórium in poténte: et exaltávi eléctum de plebe mea.
content.english: 88:20 Then thou spokest in a vision to thy saints, and saidst: * I have laid help upon one that is mighty, and have exalted one chosen out of my people.

segments.t: Tunc locútus es in visióne sanctis tuis, et dixísti: * Pósui adiutórium in poténte: et exaltávi eléctum de plebe mea.

content.latin: 88:21 Invéni David, servum meum: * óleo sancto meo unxi eum.
content.english: 88:21 I have found David my servant: * with my holy oil I have anointed him.

segments.t: Invéni David, servum meum: * óleo sancto meo unxi eum.

content.latin: 88:22 Manus enim mea auxiliábitur ei: * et brácchium meum confortábit eum.
content.english: 88:22 For my hand shall help him: * and my arm shall strengthen him.

segments.t: Manus enim mea auxiliábitur ei: * et brácchium meum confortábit eum.

content.latin: 88:23 Nihil profíciet inimícus in eo, * et fílius iniquitátis non appónet nocére ei.
content.english: 88:23 The enemy shall have no advantage over him: * nor the son of iniquity have power to hurt him.

segments.t: Nihil profíciet inimícus in eo, * et fílius iniquitátis non appónet nocére ei.

content.latin: 88:24 Et concídam a fácie ipsíus inimícos eius: * et odiéntes eum in fugam convértam.
content.english: 88:24 And I will cut down his enemies before his face; * and them that hate him I will put to flight.

segments.t: Et concídam a fácie ipsíus inimícos eius: * et odiéntes eum in fugam convértam.

content.latin: 88:25 Et véritas mea, et misericórdia mea cum ipso: * et in nómine meo exaltábitur cornu eius.
content.english: 88:25 And my truth and my mercy shall be with him: * and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

segments.t: Et véritas mea, et misericórdia mea cum ipso: * et in nómine meo exaltábitur cornu eius.

content.latin: 88:26 Et ponam in mari manum eius: * et in flumínibus déxteram eius.
content.english: 88:26 And I will set his hand in the sea; * and his right hand in the rivers.

segments.t: Et ponam in mari manum eius: * et in flumínibus déxteram eius.

content.latin: 88:27 Ipse invocábit me: Pater meus es tu: * Deus meus, et suscéptor salútis meæ.
content.english: 88:27 He shall cry out to me: Thou art my father: * my God, and the support of my salvation.

segments.t: Ipse invocábit me: Pater meus es tu: * Deus meus, et suscéptor salútis meæ.

content.latin: 88:28 Et ego primogénitum ponam illum * excélsum præ régibus terræ.
content.english: 88:28 And I will make him my firstborn, * high above the kings of the earth.

segments.t: Et ego primogénitum ponam illum * excélsum præ régibus terræ.

content.latin: 88:29 In ætérnum servábo illi misericórdiam meam: * et testaméntum meum fidéle ipsi.
content.english: 88:29 I will keep my mercy for him for ever: * and my covenant faithful to him.

segments.t: In ætérnum servábo illi misericórdiam meam: * et testaméntum meum fidéle ipsi.

content.latin: 88:30 Et ponam in sǽculum sǽculi semen eius: * et thronum eius sicut dies cæli.
content.english: 88:30 And I will make his seed to endure for evermore: * and his throne as the days of heaven.

segments.t: Et ponam in sǽculum sǽculi semen eius: * et thronum eius sicut dies cæli.

content.latin: 88:31 Si autem derelíquerint fílii eius legem meam: * et in iudíciis meis non ambuláverint:
content.english: 88:31 And if his children forsake my law, * and walk not in my judgments:

segments.t: Si autem derelíquerint fílii eius legem meam: * et in iudíciis meis non ambuláverint:

content.latin: 88:32 Si iustítias meas profanáverint: * et mandáta mea non custodíerint:
content.english: 88:32 If they profane my justices: * and keep not my commandments:

segments.t: Si iustítias meas profanáverint: * et mandáta mea non custodíerint:

content.latin: 88:33 Visitábo in virga iniquitátes eórum: * et in verbéribus peccáta eórum.
content.english: 88:33 I will visit their iniquities with a rod: *and their sins with stripes.

segments.t: Visitábo in virga iniquitátes eórum: * et in verbéribus peccáta eórum.

content.latin: 88:34 Misericórdiam autem meam non dispérgam ab eo: * neque nocébo in veritáte mea:
content.english: 88:34 But my mercy I will not take away from him: * nor will I suffer my truth to fail.

segments.t: Misericórdiam autem meam non dispérgam ab eo: * neque nocébo in veritáte mea:

content.latin: 88:35 Neque profanábo testaméntum meum: * et quæ procédunt de lábiis meis, non fáciam írrita.
content.english: 88:35 Neither will I profane my covenant: * and the words that proceed from my mouth I will not make void.

segments.t: Neque profanábo testaméntum meum: * et quæ procédunt de lábiis meis, non fáciam írrita.

content.latin: 88:36 Semel iurávi in sancto meo: Si David méntiar: * semen eius in ætérnum manébit.
content.english: 88:36 Once have I sworn by my holiness: I will not lie unto David: * his seed shall endure for ever.

segments.t: Semel iurávi in sancto meo: Si David méntiar: * semen eius in ætérnum manébit.

content.latin: 88:37 Et thronus eius sicut sol in conspéctu meo, * et sicut luna perfécta in ætérnum: et testis in cælo fidélis.
content.english: 88:37 And his throne as the sun before me: * and as the moon perfect for ever, and a faithful witness in heaven.

segments.t: Et thronus eius sicut sol in conspéctu meo, * et sicut luna perfécta in ætérnum: et testis in cælo fidélis.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Ipse invocábit me, allelúia: Pater meus es tu, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. He shall cry unto Me, alleluia, Thou art My Father, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Ipse invocábit me, allelúia: Pater meus es tu, allelúia.

content.latin: Ant. Læténtur cæli, * et exsúltet terra ante fáciem Dómini, quóniam venit.
content.english: Ant. Let the heavens rejoice, * and let the earth be glad before the Lord, for He cometh.

segments.t: Ant.
Læténtur cæli, * et exsúltet terra ante fáciem Dómini, quóniam venit.

content.latin: Psalmus 95 [8]
content.english: Psalm 95 [8]

segments.t: Psalmus 95

content.latin: 95:1 Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * cantáte Dómino, omnis terra.
content.english: 95:1 Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * sing to the Lord, all the earth.

segments.t: Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * cantáte Dómino, omnis terra.

content.latin: 95:2 Cantáte Dómino, et benedícite nómini eius: * annuntiáte de die in diem salutáre eius.
content.english: 95:2 Sing ye to the Lord and bless his name: * shew forth his salvation from day to day.

segments.t: Cantáte Dómino, et benedícite nómini eius: * annuntiáte de die in diem salutáre eius.

content.latin: 95:3 Annuntiáte inter gentes glóriam eius, * in ómnibus pópulis mirabília eius.
content.english: 95:3 Declare his glory among the Gentiles: * his wonders among all people.

segments.t: Annuntiáte inter gentes glóriam eius, * in ómnibus pópulis mirabília eius.

content.latin: 95:4 Quóniam magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * terríbilis est super omnes deos.
content.english: 95:4 For the Lord is great, and exceedingly to be praised: * he is to be feared above all gods.

segments.t: Quóniam magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * terríbilis est super omnes deos.

content.latin: 95:5 Quóniam omnes dii géntium dæmónia: * Dóminus autem cælos fecit.
content.english: 95:5 For all the gods of the Gentiles are devils: * but the Lord made the heavens.

segments.t: Quóniam omnes dii géntium dæmónia: * Dóminus autem cælos fecit.

content.latin: 95:6 Conféssio, et pulchritúdo in conspéctu eius: * sanctimónia et magnificéntia in sanctificatióne eius.
content.english: 95:6 Praise and beauty are before him: * holiness and majesty in his sanctuary.

segments.t: Conféssio, et pulchritúdo in conspéctu eius: * sanctimónia et magnificéntia in sanctificatióne eius.

content.latin: 95:7 Afférte Dómino, pátriæ géntium, afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem: * afférte Dómino glóriam nómini eius.
content.english: 95:7 Bring ye to the Lord, O ye kindreds of the Gentiles, bring ye to the Lord glory and honour: * bring to the Lord glory unto his name.

segments.t: Afférte Dómino, pátriæ géntium, afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem: * afférte Dómino glóriam nómini eius.

content.latin: 95:8 Tóllite hóstias, et introíte in átria eius: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto eius.
content.english: 95:8 Bring up sacrifices, and come into his courts: * adore ye the Lord in his holy court.

segments.t: Tóllite hóstias, et introíte in átria eius: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto eius.

content.latin: 95:9 Commoveátur a fácie eius univérsa terra: * dícite in géntibus quia Dóminus regnávit.
content.english: 95:9 Let all the earth be moved at his presence. * Say ye among the Gentiles, the Lord hath reigned.

segments.t: Commoveátur a fácie eius univérsa terra: * dícite in géntibus quia Dóminus regnávit.

content.latin: 95:10 Étenim corréxit orbem terræ qui non commovébitur: * iudicábit pópulos in æquitáte.
content.english: 95:10 For he hath corrected the world, which shall not be moved: * he will judge the people with justice.

segments.t: Étenim corréxit orbem terræ qui non commovébitur: * iudicábit pópulos in æquitáte.

content.latin: 95:11 Læténtur cæli, et exsúltet terra: commoveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: * gaudébunt campi, et ómnia quæ in eis sunt.
content.english: 95:11 Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad, let the sea be moved, and the fulness thereof: * the fields and all things that are in them shall be joyful.

segments.t: Læténtur cæli, et exsúltet terra: commoveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: * gaudébunt campi, et ómnia quæ in eis sunt.

content.latin: 95:12 Tunc exsultábunt ómnia ligna silvárum a fácie Dómini, quia venit: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.
content.english: 95:12 Then shall all the trees of the woods rejoice before the face of the Lord, because he cometh: * because he cometh to judge the earth.

segments.t: Tunc exsultábunt ómnia ligna silvárum a fácie Dómini, quia venit: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.

content.latin: 95:13 Iudicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, * et pópulos in veritáte sua.
content.english: 95:13 He shall judge the world with justice, * and the people with his truth.

segments.t: Iudicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, * et pópulos in veritáte sua.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Læténtur cæli, et exsúltet terra ante fáciem Dómini, quóniam venit.
content.english: Ant. Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad before the Lord, for He cometh.

segments.t: Ant.
Læténtur cæli, et exsúltet terra ante fáciem Dómini, quóniam venit.

content.latin: Ant. Notum fecit * Dóminus, allelúia, salutáre suum, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. The Lord hath made known, alleluia, * His salvation, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Notum fecit * Dóminus, allelúia, salutáre suum, allelúia.

content.latin: Psalmus 97 [9]
content.english: Psalm 97 [9]

segments.t: Psalmus 97

content.latin: 97:1 Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * quia mirabília fecit.
content.english: 97:1 Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * because he hath done wonderful things.

segments.t: Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * quia mirabília fecit.

content.latin: 97:1 Salvávit sibi déxtera eius: * et brácchium sanctum eius.
content.english: 97:1 His right hand hath wrought for him salvation, * and his arm is holy.

segments.t: Salvávit sibi déxtera eius: * et brácchium sanctum eius.

content.latin: 97:2 Notum fecit Dóminus salutáre suum: * in conspéctu géntium revelávit iustítiam suam.
content.english: 97:2 The Lord hath made known his salvation: * he hath revealed his justice in the sight of the Gentiles.

segments.t: Notum fecit Dóminus salutáre suum: * in conspéctu géntium revelávit iustítiam suam.

content.latin: 97:3 Recordátus est misericórdiæ suæ, * et veritátis suæ dómui Israël.
content.english: 97:3 He hath remembered his mercy * and his truth toward the house of Israel.

segments.t: Recordátus est misericórdiæ suæ, * et veritátis suæ dómui Israël.

content.latin: 97:3 Vidérunt omnes términi terræ * salutáre Dei nostri.
content.english: 97:3 All the ends of the earth have seen * the salvation of our God.

segments.t: Vidérunt omnes términi terræ * salutáre Dei nostri.

content.latin: 97:4 Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * cantáte, et exsultáte, et psállite.
content.english: 97:4 Sing joyfully to God, all the earth; * make melody, rejoice and sing.

segments.t: Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * cantáte, et exsultáte, et psállite.

content.latin: 97:5 Psállite Dómino in cíthara, in cíthara et voce psalmi: * in tubis ductílibus, et voce tubæ córneæ.
content.english: 97:5 Sing praise to the Lord on the harp, on the harp, and with the voice of a psalm: * with long trumpets, and sound of cornet.

segments.t: Psállite Dómino in cíthara, in cíthara et voce psalmi: * in tubis ductílibus, et voce tubæ córneæ.

content.latin: 97:6 Iubiláte in conspéctu regis Dómini: * moveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: orbis terrárum, et qui hábitant in eo.
content.english: 97:6 Make a joyful noise before the Lord our king: * let the sea be moved and the fulness thereof: the world and they that dwell therein.

segments.t: Iubiláte in conspéctu regis Dómini: * moveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: orbis terrárum, et qui hábitant in eo.

content.latin: 97:8 Flúmina plaudent manu, simul montes exsultábunt a conspéctu Dómini: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.
content.english: 97:8 The rivers shall clap their hands, the mountains shall rejoice together at the presence of the Lord: * because he cometh to judge the earth.

segments.t: Flúmina plaudent manu, simul montes exsultábunt a conspéctu Dómini: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.

content.latin: 97:9 Iudicábit orbem terrárum in iustítia, * et pópulos in æquitáte.
content.english: 97:9 He shall judge the world with justice, * and the people with equity.

segments.t: Iudicábit orbem terrárum in iustítia, * et pópulos in æquitáte.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Notum fecit Dóminus, allelúia, salutáre suum, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. The Lord hath made known, alleluia, His salvation, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Notum fecit Dóminus, allelúia, salutáre suum, allelúia.

content.latin: ℣. Ipse invocábit me, allelúia.
content.english: ℣. He shall cry unto Me, alleluia.

segments.t: Ipse invocábit me, allelúia.

content.latin: ℟. Pater meus es tu, allelúia.
content.english: ℟. Thou art My Father, alleluia.

segments.t: Pater meus es tu, allelúia.

content.latin: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
content.english: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

segments.t: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris:
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.

content.latin: ℣. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
content.english: ℣. And lead us not into temptation:

segments.t: Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:

content.latin: ℟. Sed líbera nos a malo.
content.english: ℟. But deliver us from evil.

segments.t: Sed líbera nos a malo.

content.latin: Absolutio. Ipsíus píetas et misericórdia nos ádiuvet, qui cum Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivit et regnat in sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Absolution. May His loving-kindness and mercy help us, Who liveth and reigneth with the Father, and the Holy Ghost, world without end.

segments.t: Absolutio.
Ipsíus píetas et misericórdia nos ádiuvet, qui cum Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivit et regnat in sǽcula sæculórum.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Deus Pater omnípotens sit nobis propítius et clemens.
content.english: Benediction. May God the Father Omnipotent, be to us merciful and clement.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Deus Pater omnípotens sit nobis propítius et clemens.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: Incipit Epístola beáti Pauli Apóstoli ad Romános
content.english: Beginning of the letter of St. Paul the Apostle to the Romans

content.latin: 1 Paulus, servus Iesu Christi, vocátus Apóstolus, segregátus in Evangélium Dei,
content.english: 1 Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

segments.t: Paulus, servus Iesu Christi, vocátus Apóstolus, segregátus in Evangélium Dei,

content.latin: 2 Quod ante promíserat per prophétas suos in Scriptúris sanctis
content.english: 2 Which he had promised before, by his prophets, in the holy scriptures,

segments.t: Quod ante promíserat per prophétas suos in Scriptúris sanctis

content.latin: 3 De Fílio suo, qui factus est ei ex sémine David secúndum carnem,
content.english: 3 Concerning his Son, who was made to him of the seed of David, according to the flesh,

segments.t: De Fílio suo, qui factus est ei ex sémine David secúndum carnem,

content.latin: 4 Qui prædestinátus est Fílius Dei in virtúte secúndum spíritum sanctificatiónis ex resurrectióne mortuórum Iesu Christi Dómini nostri:
content.english: 4 Who was predestinated the Son of God in power, according to the spirit of sanctification, by the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ from the dead;

segments.t: Qui prædestinátus est Fílius Dei in virtúte secúndum spíritum sanctificatiónis ex resurrectióne mortuórum Iesu Christi Dómini nostri:

content.latin: 5 Per quem accépimus grátiam, et apostolátum ad obediéndum fídei in ómnibus géntibus pro nómine eius,
content.english: 5 By whom we have received grace and apostleship for obedience to the faith, in all nations, for his name;

segments.t: Per quem accépimus grátiam, et apostolátum ad obediéndum fídei in ómnibus géntibus pro nómine eius,

content.latin: 6 In quibus estis et vos vocáti Iesu Christi:
content.english: 6 Among whom are you also the called of Jesus Christ:

segments.t: In quibus estis et vos vocáti Iesu Christi:

content.latin: 7 Ómnibus qui sunt Romæ, diléctis Dei, vocátis sanctis. Grátia vobis, et pax a Deo Patre nostro, et Dómino Iesu Christo.
content.english: 7 To all that are at Rome, the beloved of God, called to be saints. Grace to you, and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

segments.t: Ómnibus qui sunt Romæ, diléctis Dei, vocátis sanctis. Grátia vobis, et pax a Deo Patre nostro, et Dómino Iesu Christo.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟. Hódie nobis de cælo pax vera descéndit:
content.english: ℟. This day is the true peace come down unto us from heaven.

segments.t: Hódie nobis de cælo pax vera descéndit:

content.latin: * Hódie per totum mundum mellíflui facti sunt cæli.
content.english: * This day throughout the whole world the skies drop down sweetness.

content.latin: ℣. Hódie illúxit nobis dies redemptiónis novæ, reparatiónis antíquæ, felicitátis ætérnæ.
content.english: ℣. This day is the daybreak of our new redemption, of the restoring of the old, of everlasting joy.

segments.t: Hódie illúxit nobis dies redemptiónis novæ, reparatiónis antíquæ, felicitátis ætérnæ.

content.latin: ℟. Hódie per totum mundum mellíflui facti sunt cæli.
content.english: ℟. This day throughout the whole world the skies drop down sweetness.

segments.t: Hódie per totum mundum mellíflui facti sunt cæli.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Christus perpétuæ det nobis gáudia vitæ.
content.english: Benediction. May Christ to all His people give, for ever in His sight to live.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Christus perpétuæ det nobis gáudia vitæ.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: 8 Primum quidem grátias ago Deo meo per Iesum Christum pro ómnibus vobis: quia fides vestra annuntiátur in univérso mundo.
content.english: 8 First I give thanks to my God, through Jesus Christ, for you all, because your faith is spoken of in the whole world.

segments.t: Primum quidem grátias ago Deo meo per Iesum Christum pro ómnibus vobis: quia fides vestra annuntiátur in univérso mundo.

content.latin: 9 Testis enim mihi est Deus, cui sérvio in spíritu meo in Evangélio Fílii eius, quod sine intermissióne memóriam vestri fácio
content.english: 9 For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make a commemoration of you;

segments.t: Testis enim mihi est Deus, cui sérvio in spíritu meo in Evangélio Fílii eius, quod sine intermissióne memóriam vestri fácio

content.latin: 10 Semper in oratiónibus meis: óbsecrans, si quómodo tandem aliquándo prósperum iter hábeam in voluntáte Dei veniéndi ad vos.
content.english: 10 Always in my prayers making request, if by any means now at length I may have a prosperous journey, by the will of God, to come unto you.

segments.t: Semper in oratiónibus meis: óbsecrans, si quómodo tandem aliquándo prósperum iter hábeam in voluntáte Dei veniéndi ad vos.

content.latin: 11 Desídero enim vidére vos, ut áliquid impértiar vobis grátiæ spirituális ad confirmándos vos:
content.english: 11 For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual grace, to strengthen you:

segments.t: Desídero enim vidére vos, ut áliquid impértiar vobis grátiæ spirituális ad confirmándos vos:

content.latin: 12 Id est, simul consolári in vobis per eam quæ ínvicem est, fidem vestram atque meam.
content.english: 12 That is to say, that I may be comforted together in you, by that which is common to us both, your faith and mine.

segments.t: Id est, simul consolári in vobis per eam quæ ínvicem est, fidem vestram atque meam.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟. Quem vidístis, pastóres? dícite, annuntiáte nobis, in terris quis appáruit?
content.english: ℟. O ye shepherds, speak, and tell us what ye have seen; who is appeared in the earth?

segments.t: Quem vidístis, pastóres? dícite, annuntiáte nobis, in terris quis appáruit?

content.latin: * Natum vídimus, et choros Angelórum collaudántes Dóminum.
content.english: * We saw the new-born Child, and Angels singing praise to the Lord.

content.latin: ℣. Dícite, quidnam vidístis? et annuntiáte Christi nativitátem.
content.english: ℣. Speak; what have ye seen? And tell us of the Birth of Christ.

segments.t: Dícite, quidnam vidístis? et annuntiáte Christi nativitátem.

content.latin: ℟. Natum vídimus, et choros Angelórum collaudántes Dóminum.
content.english: ℟. We saw the new-born Child, and Angels singing praise to the Lord.

segments.t: Natum vídimus, et choros Angelórum collaudántes Dóminum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Natum vídimus, et choros Angelórum collaudántes Dóminum.
content.english: ℟. We saw the new-born Child, and Angels singing praise to the Lord.

segments.t: Natum vídimus, et choros Angelórum collaudántes Dóminum.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Ignem sui amóris accéndat Deus in córdibus nostris.
content.english: Benediction. May the Spirit's fire Divine in our hearts enkindled shine.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Ignem sui amóris accéndat Deus in córdibus nostris.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: 13 Nolo autem vos ignoráre fratres: quia sæpe propósui veníre ad vos (et prohíbitus sum usque adhuc) ut áliquem fructum hábeam et in vobis, sicut et in céteris géntibus.
content.english: 13 And I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that I have often purposed to come unto you, (and have been hindered hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.

segments.t: Nolo autem vos ignoráre fratres: quia sæpe propósui veníre ad vos (et prohíbitus sum usque adhuc) ut áliquem fructum hábeam et in vobis, sicut et in céteris géntibus.

content.latin: 14 Græcis ac bárbaris, sapiéntibus, et insipiéntibus débitor sum:
content.english: 14 To the Greeks and to the barbarians, to the wise and to the unwise, I am a debtor;

segments.t: Græcis ac bárbaris, sapiéntibus, et insipiéntibus débitor sum:

content.latin: 15 Ita (quod in me) promptum est et vobis, qui Romæ estis, evangelizáre.
content.english: 15 So (as much as is in me) I am ready to preach the gospel to you also that are at Rome.

segments.t: Ita (quod in me) promptum est et vobis, qui Romæ estis, evangelizáre.

content.latin: 16 Non enim erubésco Evangélium. Virtus enim Dei est in salútem omni credénti, Iudǽo primum, et Græco.
content.english: 16 For I am not ashamed of the gospel. For it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth, to the Jew first, and to the Greek.

segments.t: Non enim erubésco Evangélium. Virtus enim Dei est in salútem omni credénti, Iudǽo primum, et Græco.

content.latin: 17 Iustítia enim Dei in eo revelátur ex fide in fidem: sicut scriptum est: Iustus autem ex fide vivit.
content.english: 17 For the justice of God is revealed therein, from faith unto faith, as it is written: The just man liveth by faith.

segments.t: Iustítia enim Dei in eo revelátur ex fide in fidem: sicut scriptum est: Iustus autem ex fide vivit.

content.latin: 18 Revelátur enim ira Dei de cælo super omnem impietátem, et iniustítiam hóminum eórum, qui veritátem Dei in iniustítia détinent:
content.english: 18 For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and injustice of those men that detain the truth of God in injustice:

segments.t: Revelátur enim ira Dei de cælo super omnem impietátem, et iniustítiam hóminum eórum, qui veritátem Dei in iniustítia détinent:

content.latin: 19 Quia quod notum est Dei, maniféstum est in illis. Deus enim illis manifestávit.
content.english: 19 Because that which is known of God is manifest in them. For God hath manifested it unto them.

segments.t: Quia quod notum est Dei, maniféstum est in illis. Deus enim illis manifestávit.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: Te Deum
content.english: Te Deum

segments.t: Te Deum

content.latin: Te Deum laudámus: * te Dóminum confitémur.
content.english: We praise thee, O God, * we acknowledge thee to be the Lord.

content.latin: Te ætérnum Patrem * omnis terra venerátur.
content.english: All the earth doth worship thee, * the Father everlasting.

content.latin: Tibi omnes Ángeli, * tibi Cæli, et univérsæ Potestátes:
content.english: To thee all Angels cry aloud, * the Heavens, and all the Powers therein.

content.latin: Tibi Chérubim et Séraphim * incessábili voce proclámant:
content.english: To thee Cherubim and Seraphim * continually do cry.

content.latin: Fit reverentia Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus * Dóminus Deus Sábaoth.
content.english: bow head Holy, Holy, Holy * Lord God of Sabaoth;

segments.t: Fit reverentia
Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus * Dóminus Deus Sábaoth.

content.latin: Pleni sunt cæli et terra * maiestátis glóriæ tuæ.
content.english: Heaven and earth are full * of the Majesty of thy glory.

content.latin: Te gloriósus * Apostolórum chorus,
content.english: The glorious company of the Apostles * praise thee.

content.latin: Te Prophetárum * laudábilis númerus,
content.english: The goodly fellowship of the Prophets * praise thee.

content.latin: Te Mártyrum candidátus * laudat exércitus.
content.english: The noble army of Martyrs * praise thee.

content.latin: Te per orbem terrárum * sancta confitétur Ecclésia,
content.english: The holy Church throughout all the world * doth acknowledge thee;

content.latin: Patrem * imménsæ maiestátis;
content.english: The Father, * of an infinite Majesty.

content.latin: Venerándum tuum verum * et únicum Fílium;
content.english: Thine honourable, true, * and only Son;

content.latin: Sanctum quoque * Paráclitum Spíritum.
content.english: Also the Holy Ghost, * the Comforter.

content.latin: Tu Rex glóriæ, * Christe.
content.english: Thou art the King of Glory, * O Christ.

content.latin: Tu Patris * sempitérnus es Fílius.
content.english: Thou art the everlasting * Son of the Father.

content.latin: Fit reverentia Tu, ad liberándum susceptúrus hóminem: * non horruísti Vírginis úterum.
content.english: During the following verse all make a profound bow: When thou tookest upon thee to deliver man, * thou didst not abhor the Virgin's womb.

segments.t: Fit reverentia
Tu, ad liberándum susceptúrus hóminem: * non horruísti Vírginis úterum.

content.latin: Tu, devícto mortis acúleo, * aperuísti credéntibus regna cælórum.
content.english: When thou hadst overcome the sharpness of death, * thou didst open the Kingdom of Heaven to all believers.

content.latin: Tu ad déxteram Dei sedes, * in glória Patris.
content.english: Thou sittest at the right hand of God, * in the glory of the Father.

content.latin: Iudex créderis * esse ventúrus.
content.english: We believe that thou shalt come * to be our Judge.

content.latin: Sequens versus dicitur flexis genibus Te ergo quǽsumus, tuis fámulis súbveni, * quos pretióso sánguine redemísti.
content.english: Kneel for the following verse We therefore pray thee, help thy servants, * whom thou hast redeemed with thy precious Blood.

segments.t: Sequens versus dicitur flexis genibus
Te ergo quǽsumus, tuis fámulis súbveni, * quos pretióso sánguine redemísti.

content.latin: Ætérna fac cum Sanctis tuis * in glória numerári.
content.english: Make them to be numbered with thy Saints, * in glory everlasting.

content.latin: Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine, * et bénedic hereditáti tuæ.
content.english: O Lord, save thy people, * and bless thine heritage.

content.latin: Et rege eos, * et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.
content.english: Govern them, * and lift them up for ever.

content.latin: Per síngulos dies * benedícimus te.
content.english: Day by day * we magnify thee;

content.latin: Fit reverentia, secundum consuetudinem Et laudámus nomen tuum in sǽculum, * et in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: During the following verse, by local custom, all make a profound bow. And we worship thy Name * ever, world without end.

segments.t: Fit reverentia, secundum consuetudinem
Et laudámus nomen tuum in sǽculum, * et in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: Dignáre, Dómine, die isto * sine peccáto nos custodíre.
content.english: Vouchsafe, O Lord, to keep us * this day without sin.

content.latin: Miserére nostri, Dómine, * miserére nostri.
content.english: O Lord, have mercy upon us, * have mercy upon us.

content.latin: Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos, * quemádmodum sperávimus in te.
content.english: O Lord, let thy mercy lighten upon us, * as our trust is in thee.

content.latin: In te, Dómine, sperávi: * non confúndar in ætérnum.
content.english: O Lord, in thee have I trusted, * let me never be confounded.

content.latin: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi separandæ sint.
content.english: Skip the rest, unless praying separately.

segments.t: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi separandæ sint.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut nos Unigéniti tui nova per carnem Natívitas líberet; quos sub peccáti iugo vetústa sérvitus tenet.
content.english: Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God, that the new birth of thy Only-begotten Son as man may set us free, who are held by the old bondage under the yoke of sin.

content.latin: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Ant. Quem vidístis, * pastóres? dícite, annuntiáte nobis, in terris quis appáruit? Natum vídimus, et choros Angelórum collaudántes Dóminum, allelúia, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. O ye shepherds, speak, * and tell us what ye have seen; who is appeared in the earth? We saw the newborn Child, and angels singing praise to the Lord, alleluia, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Quem vidístis, * pastóres? dícite, annuntiáte nobis, in terris quis appáruit? Natum vídimus, et choros Angelórum collaudántes Dóminum, allelúia, allelúia.

content.english: Psalm 92 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 92

content.latin: 92:1 Dóminus regnávit, decórem indútus est: * indútus est Dóminus fortitúdinem, et præcínxit se.
content.english: 92:1 The Lord hath reigned, he is clothed with beauty: * the Lord is clothed with strength, and hath girded himself.

segments.t: Dóminus regnávit, decórem indútus est: * indútus est Dóminus fortitúdinem, et præcínxit se.

content.latin: 92:1 Étenim firmávit orbem terræ, * qui non commovébitur.
content.english: 92:1 For he hath established the world * which shall not be moved.

segments.t: Étenim firmávit orbem terræ, * qui non commovébitur.

content.latin: 92:2 Paráta sedes tua ex tunc: * a sǽculo tu es.
content.english: 92:2 Thy throne is prepared from of old: * thou art from everlasting.

segments.t: Paráta sedes tua ex tunc: * a sǽculo tu es.

content.latin: 92:3 Elevavérunt flúmina, Dómine: * elevavérunt flúmina vocem suam.
content.english: 92:3 The floods have lifted up, O Lord: * the floods have lifted up their voice.

segments.t: Elevavérunt flúmina, Dómine: * elevavérunt flúmina vocem suam.

content.latin: 92:3 Elevavérunt flúmina fluctus suos, * a vócibus aquárum multárum.
content.english: 92:3 The floods have lifted up their waves, * with the noise of many waters.

segments.t: Elevavérunt flúmina fluctus suos, * a vócibus aquárum multárum.

content.latin: 92:4 Mirábiles elatiónes maris: * mirábilis in altis Dóminus.
content.english: 92:4 Wonderful are the surges of the sea: * wonderful is the Lord on high.

segments.t: Mirábiles elatiónes maris: * mirábilis in altis Dóminus.

content.latin: 92:5 Testimónia tua credibília facta sunt nimis: * domum tuam decet sanctitúdo, Dómine, in longitúdinem diérum.
content.english: 92:5 Thy testimonies are become exceedingly credible: * holiness becometh thy house, O Lord, unto length of days.

segments.t: Testimónia tua credibília facta sunt nimis: * domum tuam decet sanctitúdo, Dómine, in longitúdinem diérum.

Génuit puérpera * Regem, cui nomen ætérnum, et gáudia matris habens cum virginitátis honóre: nec primam símilem visa est, nec habére sequéntem, allelúia.

content.latin: Psalmus 99 [2]
content.english: Psalm 99 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 99

content.latin: 99:2 Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * servíte Dómino in lætítia.
content.english: 99:2 Sing joyfully to God, all the earth: * serve ye the Lord with gladness.

segments.t: Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * servíte Dómino in lætítia.

content.latin: 99:2 Introíte in conspéctu eius, * in exsultatióne.
content.english: 99:2 Come in before his presence * with exceeding great joy.

segments.t: Introíte in conspéctu eius, * in exsultatióne.

content.latin: 99:3 Scitóte quóniam Dóminus ipse est Deus: * ipse fecit nos, et non ipsi nos.
content.english: 99:3 Know ye that the Lord he is God: * he made us, and not we ourselves.

segments.t: Scitóte quóniam Dóminus ipse est Deus: * ipse fecit nos, et non ipsi nos.

content.latin: 99:3 Pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius: * introíte portas eius in confessióne, átria eius in hymnis: confitémini illi.
content.english: 99:3 We are his people and the sheep of his pasture. * Go ye into his gates with praise, into his courts with hymns: and give glory to him.

segments.t: Pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius: * introíte portas eius in confessióne, átria eius in hymnis: confitémini illi.

content.latin: 99:4 Laudáte nomen eius: quóniam suávis est Dóminus, in ætérnum misericórdia eius, * et usque in generatiónem et generatiónem véritas eius.
content.english: 99:4 Praise ye his name: for the Lord is sweet, his mercy endureth for ever, * and his truth to generation and generation.

segments.t: Laudáte nomen eius: quóniam suávis est Dóminus, in ætérnum misericórdia eius, * et usque in generatiónem et generatiónem véritas eius.

Angelus ad pastóres * ait: Annúntio vobis gáudium magnum: quia natus est vobis hódie Salvátor mundi, allelúia.

content.latin: Psalmus 62 [3]
content.english: Psalm 62 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 62

content.latin: 62:2 Deus, Deus meus, * ad te de luce vígilo.
content.english: 62:2 O God, my God, * to thee do I watch at break of day.

segments.t: Deus, Deus meus, * ad te de luce vígilo.

content.latin: 62:2 Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.
content.english: 62:2 For thee my soul hath thirsted; * for thee my flesh, O how many ways!

segments.t: Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.

content.latin: 62:3 In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: * sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.
content.english: 62:3 In a desert land, and where there is no way, and no water: * so in the sanctuary have I come before thee, to see thy power and thy glory.

segments.t: In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: * sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.

content.latin: 62:4 Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.
content.english: 62:4 For thy mercy is better than lives: * thee my lips shall praise.

segments.t: Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.

content.latin: 62:5 Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.
content.english: 62:5 Thus will I bless thee all my life long: * and in thy name I will lift up my hands.

segments.t: Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.

content.latin: 62:6 Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.
content.english: 62:6 Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness: * and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips.

segments.t: Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.

content.latin: 62:7 Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adiútor meus.
content.english: 62:7 If I have remembered thee upon my bed, I will meditate on thee in the morning: * because thou hast been my helper.

segments.t: Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adiútor meus.

content.latin: 62:8 Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.
content.english: 62:8 And I will rejoice under the covert of thy wings: my soul hath stuck close to thee: * thy right hand hath received me.

segments.t: Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.

content.latin: 62:10 Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.
content.english: 62:10 But they have sought my soul in vain, they shall go into the lower parts of the earth: * they shall be delivered into the hands of the sword, they shall be the portions of foxes.

segments.t: Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.

content.latin: 62:12 Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui iurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.
content.english: 62:12 But the king shall rejoice in God, all they shall be praised that swear by him: * because the mouth is stopped of them that speak wicked things.

segments.t: Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui iurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.
